item: Read-change-write sections of the expedition log and capacity ceiling hold the file lock; file_lock gives back from the gate it can see; a failed fsync no longer renames
summary: Folds of the independent read of PR 1454. Expedition arm/disarm/record_event/refresh and capacity.record_pass wrote back what they had read before another server changed it: they now hold the file's cross-process lock across the read-change-write (refresh re-reads under the lock and changes only its counters). file_lock: an interrupt right after the reader mark or inside the hold statistic left the gate held; release is now read from the gate and the statistic is counted after the release; the gate key is the absolute path. atomic_replace renamed data over a good file after a failed fsync; only EINVAL/ENOTSUP are tolerated now. 8 new tests, each red without its change.
